For a=e1,b=2e2-e1,c=3e3-e1-e2, N6=6(a.a)+2(b.b)+(c.c), C18=(b.b)(c.c)-(b.c)^2+3[(c.c)(a.a)-(c.a)^2]+6[(a.a)(b.b)-(a.b)^2]; SICN_squared=1944*det^2/(N6*C18). Every det>0 and squared>=1/100 is required.
